credit_and_scope: Classical saddle-point method, not a novelty claim. TURN_2 directly checks the transfer-matrix spectral suppression and supplies the correction/error argument; it does not assume the Perron eigenvalue itself has a nonnegative Taylor series or invoke the scalar theorem without its hypotheses.
